source: script v1, written 26 Nov 2026 from the approved concept (Claude Doc 采访月老的一天: concept and beat outline)

title.en: A Day Interviewing the Old Man under the Moon

speakers.ji: 记者 (the camera, never seen; standard Mandarin, the series voice)
speakers.yl: 月老 (the lead: old, quick, fussy, warm underneath)
speakers.xm: 林小满 (30, programmer, flat and tired)
speakers.ma: 小满妈 (praying at the temple, loud)

lines.en: Yue Lao? Have the threads kidnapped you?

screens.en: Yue Lao? Have the threads kidnapped you?

lines.tts: [surprised, amused] 月老？您被线绑架了？

lines.en: Don't move! One tug and three couples divorce.

screens.en: Don't move! One tug and three couples divorce.

lines.emo: hissed through a thread in his teeth, dead serious
lines.tts: [urgent, hissing] 别动！一动，三对离婚。

lines.zh: 等等……您是天庭派来考核的吧？
lines.en: Wait... Heaven sent you for my review, didn't it?

screens.zh: 您是天庭派来考核的吧？

lines.tts: [suspicious] 等等……[nervous, fawning] 您是天庭派来考核的吧？

lines.en: Uh? Actually I'm...
lines.tts: [confused] 啊？我其实是——

lines.en: Got it! Undercover. Write it all down, please.

screens.en: Got it! Undercover. Write it all down, please.

lines.tts: [cutting in, eager] 懂！暗访。[fawning] 您记，随便记。

lines.zh: 姻缘司，上下就我一个。别人九九六，我零零七。
lines.en: The Marriage Bureau is just me. Others work 996. I work 007.

screens.en: The Marriage Bureau is just me.

lines.tts: [sighs] 姻缘司，上下就我一个。别人九九六，[dry] 我零零七。

lines.en: How many couples a day?
Eighteen thousand.
And seven and a half thousand split, the same day.

screens.en: And seven and a half thousand split, the same day.

lines.tts: [deflated] 可一天，也散七千五。

card.zh: 2025年结婚676.3万对，离婚274.3万对（民政部）

lines.zh: 现在的年轻人，线刚绑上，自己就剪了。
lines.en: Young people now: I tie it, they cut it.

lines.zh: 今年指标，就差一对。今晚子时截止。
lines.en: This year's target is one couple short. Deadline: midnight.
What if you're one short?
They dock my elixir. And I write a self-criticism.

screens.en: They dock my elixir. And I write a self-criticism.

lines.tts: [miserable] 扣仙丹。还得写检讨。

lines.zh: 不过您先看看，我的老业绩！
lines.en: But first, look at my past results!

screens.zh: 不过您先看看，我的老业绩！
screens.en: But first, look at my past results!

lines.en: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl. Mine! Solid, eh?

screens.en: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl. Mine! Solid, eh?

lines.tts: [proud] 牛郎织女。我绑的！牢吧？

lines.en: They meet once a year.
...Long distance still counts.
lines.tts: [awkward, quiet] ……异地恋，也算成。

lines.zh: 梁山伯祝英台。……变蝴蝶了。这单别记。
lines.en: Liang and Zhu. ...They became butterflies. Don't write that one.
lines.emo: proud, then sees the file, shuts it fast
lines.tts: 梁山伯祝英台。[hesitates] ……变蝴蝶了。[quickly] 这单别记。

lines.zh: 许仙白娘子。跨物种，审批走了一千年。
lines.en: Xu Xian and Lady White Snake. Cross-species: approval took a thousand years.

screens.en: Xu Xian and Lady White Snake.

screens.zh: 跨物种，审批走了一千年。
screens.en: Cross-species: approval took a thousand years.

lines.zh: 宝玉黛玉。手一抖，绑成了宝钗。
lines.en: Baoyu and Daiyu. My hand slipped. He got Baochai.
lines.tts: 宝玉黛玉。[guilty, small] 手一抖，绑成了宝钗。

lines.en: Readers have cursed me for two hundred years.

screens.en: Readers have cursed me for two hundred years.

lines.zh: 董永七仙女——那是玉帝的亲闺女。
lines.en: Dong Yong and the Seventh Fairy. She was the Jade Emperor's own daughter.

screens.en: Dong Yong and the Seventh Fairy.
She was the Jade Emperor's own daughter.

lines.tts: 董永七仙女——[whispers] 那是玉帝的亲闺女。

lines.en: And the Jade Emperor...?
Docked three hundred years of elixir.

screens.en: Docked three hundred years of elixir.

lines.tts: [flat] 扣了我三百年仙丹。

lines.en: An order! From my temple. Urgent!

screens.en: An order! From my temple. Urgent!

lines.tts: [excited] 来单了！月老庙，加急！

lines.zh: 月老保佑！我闺女三十了，天天加班，就是不找对象！
lines.en: Bless us, Yue Lao! My girl is thirty, works every night, and won't find anyone!

screens.zh: 月老保佑！我闺女三十了，
screens.en: Bless us, Yue Lao! My girl is

screens.zh: 天天加班，就是不找对象！
screens.en: thirty, works every night, and won't find anyone!

lines.tts: [pleading, loud] 月老保佑！我闺女三十了，天天加班，就是不找对象！

lines.zh: 今年再不成，我就不起来了！
lines.en: If it doesn't happen this year, I'm not getting up!

screens.zh: 今年再不成，我就不起来了！
screens.en: If it doesn't happen this year, I'm not getting up!

lines.tts: [stubborn] 今年再不成，我就不起来了！

lines.zh: 就她了！林小满。今晚必须绑上。
lines.en: Her! Lin Xiaoman. Tied by tonight.
Hold the thread and follow me!

screens.en: Hold the thread and follow me!

lines.emo: thrusting the spool at the lens

lines.en: Shh. Mortals can't see us.
lines.tts: [whispers] 嘘。凡人看不见咱们。

lines.en: The ankle? Not the wrist?
lines.tts: [whispers, puzzled] 绑脚？不是绑手吗？

lines.zh: 唐朝起就绑脚。绑手，是电视剧瞎改的。
lines.en: Ankles, since the Tang. Wrists are a TV invention.

card.zh: 唐《定婚店》：赤绳“以系夫妻之足”
card.en: Tang tale 'The Inn of Betrothal': the red cord 'ties the feet of husband and wife'

lines.en: No. No. Next.
lines.tts: [flat, bored] 不合适。不合适。下一个。

lines.zh: 哎哎哎！她左滑一下，我断一根！
lines.en: Hey hey hey! Every left swipe snaps one of mine!
lines.tts: [panicking] 哎哎哎！她左滑一下，我断一根！

lines.en: This one... write it down as 'not fated yet'.

screens.en: This one... write it down as

lines.emo: recovering, to the lens, a weak smile
lines.tts: [embarrassed] 这个……您记成，缘分未到。

lines.zh: 没事！她妈安排了相亲。这回稳了。
lines.en: No matter! Her mum set up a blind date. This one's safe.

screens.en: No matter! Her mum set up
a blind date. This one's safe.

lines.en: Hello. Own a flat? Monthly salary?

screens.en: Hello. Own a flat? Monthly salary?

lines.en: Can you live with 996?
Sorry, I need to answer a message.

screens.en: Sorry, I need to answer a message.

lines.en: Good. I'll fix a bug.
...This one too. 'Not fated yet.'
lines.tts: [defeated] ……这个，也记，缘分未到。

lines.en: Where's the thread? My thread!
lines.tts: [frantic] 线呢？我的线呢！

lines.zh: 别动别动——缠您法器上了。
lines.en: Don't move, don't move. It's wound round your instrument.
Ms Lin, your delivery!
lines.emo: calling, a little out of breath, in the background
lines.tts: [calling out, cheerful] 林女士，您的外卖！

lines.en: Thanks. You again.
One 'shichen' left. ...I'm done for.
lines.tts: 还剩一个时辰。[sighs, hopeless] ……完了。

lines.en: And you yourself?
lines.tts: [gently] 那您自己呢？
[quietly] ……我？

lines.zh: 当年太忙。想着忙完这阵，就给自己绑一根。
lines.en: I was too busy back then. I thought: after this rush, I'll tie one for myself.

screens.en: rush, I'll tie one for myself.

lines.emo: quiet, looking at the cut thread
lines.tts: [softly, slowly] 当年太忙。想着忙完这阵，就给自己绑一根。

lines.zh: 这一阵，忙了一千二百年。
lines.en: The rush has lasted twelve hundred years.

screens.zh: 这一阵，忙了一千二百年。
screens.en: The rush has lasted twelve hundred years.

lines.tts: [soft, wry] 这一阵，忙了一千二百年。

lines.zh: 我这个……也记“缘分未到”吧。
lines.en: Mine... write it down as 'not fated yet', too.
lines.tts: [very softly] 我这个……也记，缘分未到吧。

lines.zh: 等等。这根线……不是我绑的。
lines.en: Wait. This thread... I didn't tie it.
lines.tts: [noticing] 等等。[puzzled] 这根线……不是我绑的。

lines.zh: 早就在这儿了。让我的线，盖住了。
lines.en: It was here all along. Buried under mine.
What was I rushing for.
lines.tts: [soft laugh] 我急什么呢。

lines.zh: 又加班啊？今天给你多加了个蛋。
lines.en: Late again? I had them add an extra egg today.
...Thank you. What's your name?
lines.emo: looks up for the first time, a real smile
lines.tts: [surprised, warm] ……谢谢。你叫什么名字？

lines.zh: 成了！快记！我绑的！全是我绑的！
lines.en: Done! Write it! I tied it! All me!
lines.tts: [shouting, overjoyed] 成了！快记！我绑的！全是我绑的！

lines.en: Wasn't it there all along?
lines.tts: [dry] 不是早就在那儿吗？

lines.en: Ahem... put that down as 'fated at last'.
lines.tts: [coughs] 咳……这句，记成，缘分已到。

lines.en: And my thread?
lines.tts: [curious, hopeful] 那我的那根呢？

lines.en: Yours? Tied long ago.
lines.emo: flips the book, smiles at the lens
lines.tts: [warm] 你的？早绑好了。

lines.en: It's someone you have already met.

screens.en: It's someone you have already met.

lines.tts: [warm, slowly] 是你已经见过的人。
